messages.subject: (Cumulative) Average flow time per resource?
messages.body_plain:
Cheers guys,

I'm currently (ab)using simmer to simulate run times of requests in different types of server architectures...  Loving it so far! Thanks a lot for all the work you've put in over the years. However, there's one thing I cannot seem to wrap my head around.

Question:

I would like to know the cumulative average flow time per resource. The goal is to plot how the average time for a request responds to increasing user load.
Is there any way to sanely extract this information from simmer?

(Overly verbose) Example trajectory:

t <- trajectory() %>%
    seize("getOverview()", 1) %>%
        seize("getUser()", 1) %>%
            seize("getUserData()", 3) %>%
                timeout(0.2) %>%
            release("getUserData()", 3) %>%
            seize("getUserProducts()", 1) %>%
                timeout(0.5) %>%
            release("getUserProducts()", 1) %>%
            seize("processUserInformation()", 1) %>%
                timeout(0.05) %>%
            release("processUserInformation()", 1) %>%
        release("getUser()") %>%
        seize("generateOutput()", 1) %>%
            timeout(0.25) %>%
        release("generateOutput()", 1) %>%
    release("getOverview()", 1)

Ideal result:
Data.frame with the columns: resource; simulation_time, avg_flow_time; avg_activity_time; avg_waiting_time

In our example the output could be:
getOverview(); 0; NA; NA; NA
getUser(); 0; NA; NA; NA
getUserData(); 0; NA; NA; NA
getUserProducts(); 0; NA; NA; NA
processUserInformation; 0; NA; NA; NA
generateOutput(); 0; NA; NA; NA
getOverview(); 1; 1; 1; 0
getUser(); 1; 0.75; 0.75; 0
getUserData(); 1; 0.2; 0.2; 0
getUserProducts(); 1; 0.5; 0.5; 0
processUserInformation; 0; 0.05; 0.05; NA
generateOutput(); 1; 0.25; 0.25; 0
...

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Fri, 5 Nov 2021 at 19:55, Roman A. Abashin <ro...@nougat.ai> wrote:
> Cheers guys,
>
> I'm currently (ab)using simmer to simulate run times of requests in different types of server architectures...  Loving it so far! Thanks a lot for all the work you've put in over the years. However, there's one thing I cannot seem to wrap my head around.
>
> Question:
>
> I would like to know the cumulative average flow time per resource. The goal is to plot how the average time for a request responds to increasing user load.
> Is there any way to sanely extract this information from simmer?

Did you try simmer.plot? For instance, for a given simulation in a simulation environment called "env", you can try:

library(simmer.plot)
arrivals <- get_mon_arrivals(env)
plot(arrivals, "activity_time")
plot(arrivals, "waiting_time")
plot(arrivals, "flow_time")

If you want this information on a per-resource basis, then,

arrivals <- get_mon_arrivals(env, per_resource=TRUE)
plot(arrivals, "activity_time") + facet_wrap("resource")
plot(arrivals, "waiting_time") + facet_wrap("resource")
plot(arrivals, "flow_time") + facet_wrap("resource")

You'll find the source for these computations in [1]. Then you can use e.g. the zoo package to compute rolling averages.

[1] https://github.com/r-simmer/simmer.plot/blob/master/R/plot.arrivals.R

Iñaki
